title: 第三章 名额第章 家人
content_zh:
“你是说，他在第一次修炼淬元功的时候，就完成了洗髓！？”齐达有些错愕的抬起头；
黄波满脸喜色“对！我确定！
校长，咱们一中这次，可是出了个武道天才啊！
按照惯例，是不是”
除了汇报喜讯之外，他还有一层意思是为了楚元要好处来的。
齐达的脸上露出笑意，正要说话，忽然想到了什么似的，嘬了嘬牙花；
黄波心里咯噔一下“校长，难道有什么意外？”
齐达露出恼色“还真有我也是刚要个跟你说，玉南府李家即将来一位转校生。”
“李家！？转到我们学校！？”黄波不能理解，大秦三十六府，晨阳市只是玉南府麾下一个不起眼的小地方；
而李家在玉南府可以算得上庞然大物，家族内武道实力强横！
甚至，李家家主已经是七阶武者怎么会看得上小小的晨阳一中？
齐达喟然长叹，解释道“上头有一个培养计划，准备把全国的天才聚集起来，一同培养；
除了那些大城、州府所在，其余每个市有三个种子名额”
黄波瞬间了然，有些气愤“是为了抢这个名额来的？这不公平！
他在州府抢不过别人，就跑来我们这种小地方抢？
校长，你怎么会答应这种事！？”
“我我怎么知道这一届学生里会出现一个直接洗髓的天才！？”齐达苦笑道“没了我们一中，那不是还有二中？三中？李家那小子去哪里不一样？
我一开始想着，答应下来，好歹还能给学校落点好处，李家是真大方
除此之外也能给一中增加点名气，毕竟他的成绩算在一中，来年申请预算也好说”
早知道不答应了，李家那小子再强，也不是自己人；

可既然已经答应下来，也不好反悔，否则岂不是打了李家的脸
倒也不是说一中容不下两名天才学生，但学校能申请的最高资格扶持名额只有一个。
这份资源，给谁？
给楚元的话，李家那小子会善罢甘休么？扶持名额内的资源对他来说可能不多，但这是一个面子问题
给李家那小子，对楚元也不公平
“不管怎么说，修炼不能耽搁；
我先从李家给的资源中划分一部分，你交给楚元让他先用着。”
黄波也是知道齐达的难处，虽然仍有些愤懑，也只得闷闷答应下来
“楚元，你跟我来一些。”
黄波陡然出声，打断了杨易和楚元之间的闲聊；
其实两个人关系不错，或者说，杨易和班里的每个同学关系都不错。
甚至他还帮过楚元一些忙
一路来到黄波办公室，黄波示意楚元坐下。
也不卖关子，直接取出几个玉瓶放在桌子上，组织了一下语言开口“你的天赋，校长已经知道了，他让我把这些东西交给你。”
“这是气血丹，能加速气血的积累，但必须彻底消化后才能服用下一粒”
“这瓶是壮骨丹，搭配气血丹使用效果更佳”
“凝神丹”
楚元虽然知道，在自己的天赋显露之后，一定能得到培养；
但也没想到居然这么快
content_en:
"You mean, he completed the marrow cleansing the first time he practiced Yuan Yuan Gong!?" Qida raised his head in astonishment;
Huang Bo's face was filled with joy, "Yes! I'm sure!
Principal, we have a martial arts genius this time in our first high school!
As per usual, isn’t it?”
In addition to reporting the good news, he also came here for Chu Yuan's benefit.
Qi Da had a smile on his face and was about to speak when he suddenly thought of something and smacked his teeth;
Huang Bo's heart skipped a beat: "Principal, is there any accident?"
Qi Da showed annoyance, "Really, I just wanted to tell you that a transfer student is coming to the Li family in Yunan Mansion."
"Li family!? Transfer to our school!?" Huang Bo couldn't understand that Chenyang City, the Thirty-sixth Prefecture of the Qin Dynasty, was just an inconspicuous small place under the Yunan Prefecture;
And the Li family can be considered a behemoth in Yunan Mansion, and the martial arts within the family are powerful!
In fact, how could the head of the Li family, who is already a seventh-level warrior, like the little Chenyang No. 1 Middle School?
Qi Da sighed and explained, "There is a training plan from above, which is ready to gather the geniuses from all over the country and train them together;
Except for those big cities and state capitals, each city has three seed quotas."
Huang Bo understood instantly and was a little angry, "Are you here to grab this spot? This is unfair!
He couldn't rob others in the state capital, so he came to a small place like ours to rob him?
Principal, how could you agree to such a thing! ? "
"How do I know that there will be a genius who can directly cleanse the marrow among this class of students!?" Qi Da smiled bitterly and said, "Without our first middle school, wouldn't there be a second middle school? A third middle school? What's different about that kid from the Li family?"
At first I thought that if I agreed, I would be able to benefit the school. The Li family is so generous.
In addition, it can also increase the reputation of the No. 1 Middle School. After all, his grades count towards the No. 1 Middle School, and it will be easy to apply for the budget next year."
If I had known that I would not agree, no matter how strong that boy from the Li family is, he is not one of our own;
But since you have already agreed, you can't go back on your word, otherwise it would be a slap in the Li family's face.
That’s not to say that No. 1 Middle School can’t accommodate two gifted students, but the school can only apply for one of the highest qualification support places.
Who is this resource for?
If you give it to Chu Yuan, will that boy from the Li family give up? The resources within the support quota may not be much for him, but this is a matter of face.
It's not fair to Chu Yuan to give it to that boy from the Li family.
“No matter what, you can’t delay your practice;
I will first divide some of the resources given by the Li family, and you can give them to Chu Yuan for him to use first. "
Huang Bo also knew Qida's difficulties. Although he was still a little angry, he had no choice but to agree.
"Chu Yuan, come with me."
Huang Bo suddenly spoke up, interrupting the chat between Yang Yi and Chu Yuan;
In fact, the two of them have a good relationship, or in other words, Yang Yi has a good relationship with every student in the class.
He even helped Chu Yuan a little bit
All the way to Huang Bo's office, Huang Bo motioned Chu Yuan to sit down.
Without showing off, he directly took out a few jade bottles and placed them on the table. He organized his speech and said, "The principal already knows about your talent. He asked me to give these things to you."
"This is Qi and Blood Pill, which can accelerate the accumulation of Qi and blood, but it must be thoroughly digested before taking the next pill."
"This bottle is a bone-strengthening pill. It will be more effective when used together with the Qi-blood pill."
"Concentration Pill"
Although Chu Yuan knew that after his talent was revealed, he would definitely be able to cultivate it;
But I didn't expect it to be so fast
